title: Repair tunnel corpus UDP construction
description: Recovery review found existing test/vectors/generate_tunnel_encapsulation.py:64-74 uses udp[1:2]=udp[0:2], expanding header to nine bytes, then writes length into destination port, leaving UDP length zero. Existing corpus remains usable for IPv6-only decapsulation but is not valid end-to-end UDP evidence. Also isolate inner-destination rejection from outer-destination mismatch, add outer-length-consistent truncated-inner case, and isolate hop budget boundary HL4/SL2 from duplicate-hop rejection. Preserve existing negatives; independently derive expected bytes rather than using production implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Generator constructs valid UDP headers/checksums using independent oracle; existing negatives retained and isolated cases added; regenerated fixtures and consumers pass without weakening implementation checks.
